title: Last Nail:Twitter permanently bans Alex Jones and website Infowars
text:
Last Nail:Twitter permanently bans Alex Jones and website Infowars Written by Reuters
(Reuters) - Twitter Inc (TWTR.N) said on Thursday that it had permanently banned U.S. conspiracy theorist Alex Jones and his website Infowars from its platform and Periscope.
The company said in a tweet that the accounts violated its behavior policies.
Last month, Twitter banned Jones and Infowars for seven days, citing tweets that it said violated the company’s rules against abusive behavior, which state that a user may not engage in targeted harassment of someone or incite other people to do so.
